If 14p55r4⋅X=7p210r3, then what is X?

Fri, Sep 18th @ 4:56 PM|Elapsed: 3:49Correct

Since 14p55r4⋅X=7p210r3, we have X=7p210r3÷14p55r4.

To compute this quotient, we just need to multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor:

7p210r3÷14p55r4=7p210r3⋅5r414p5=7p22⋅5r3⋅5r3⋅r2⋅7p2⋅p3=7p22⋅5r3⋅5r3⋅r2⋅7p2⋅p3=12⋅r2p3=r4p3
